content:
Ravi Desai: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem on the vendor cascade (cloud provider + model-registry auth). Opening thread to lock owners and dates.
Nina Brooks: I'll track the action list. Top items: auth fallback, token rotation policy, provider-routing escalation, and a drill. Who volunteers?
Evan Cho: I'll own the auth fallback shim. Plan: add a 60s cached token in edge proxy with feature flag ff.auth_fallback. Will open a small PR with tests by EOD tomorrow.
Marta Ruiz: I'll take token rotation & runbook. Proposal: rotate at 75% TTL, add a KMS-staged dry-run in staging. Draft runbook by Wed and schedule dry-run Thu.
Ravi Desai: OpsBot, paste incident link and brief metrics we discussed.
OpsBot: Incident IR-2026-047: https://redwood.incidents/IR-2026-047. Peak impact ~1.1% of traffic, duration ~38m. Runbook seed: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/vendor-cascade.
Nina Brooks: I'll update vendor escalation contacts and SLA doc; target EOW. Also creating spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-vendor-followups.
Evan Cho: Implementation detail: primary auth check -> if 5xx/timeout, swap to cached token for requests up to 60s. Pseudocode: \n```\nif auth_ok(): forward()\nelse:\n  use_cached_token()\n```\nFlag gated.
Marta Ruiz: For monitoring, suggest alert: model_registry.auth_fail_rate > 0.6% for 5m -> page SRE and run fallback routing. I'll own the alert and add a weekly synthetic test Tue 03:00 UTC.
Ravi Desai: Summary timeline: Evan PR by EOD tomorrow; Marta runbook draft Wed + dry-run Thu; Nina vendor/SLA updates EOW; Nina to start weekly 15m sync next Mon. Please drop PR/runbook links in the sheet and mark DONE when complete.
Nina Brooks: Also recommending a 90-minute cross-team drill after these are live. I'll propose dates in the weekly sync.
Evan Cho: Will post PR link here when ready.
Marta Ruiz: I'll post the runbook link after review.
Ravi Desai: Thanks everyone. Keep updates short in this thread. :thumbsup:
